summary: Inline micro-chart (line or area) to show a trend next to a number; the accessible name summarizes first, last, minimum, and maximum.
whenToUse: Compact trend inside KPIs, tables, or cards.
When the shape of the trend matters more than individual values.
whenNotToUse: When you need axes, individual values, or multiple series: use LineChart.
As the only carrier of important data: always show the value as text too.

props.name: data
props.description: Values in order; non-finite values leave a gap.

props.name: label
props.description: What the data represents; becomes the accessible name together with the localized summary.

props.name: variant
props.description: Line only or line with area.

props.name: width
props.description: Width in px (never wider than the container).

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Value format in the accessible summary.

inherits: SVG attributes of the <svg> (className, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <svg>.
accessibility: role="img" with aria-label "<label>: From <first> to <last>; minimum <min>, maximum <max>." (chartSummary message, localized, numbers formatted with Intl).
It is not focusable and has no interactions: the current value must also be shown as text.
In forced-colors mode the line and end point use CanvasText.
responsive: max-inline-size: 100% and proportional height: it shrinks in narrow containers.
customization: Color: colorIndex or the --_series variable on the element.
commonMistakes: Using a generic label such as "chart": describe the metric and the period.
Relying on the sparkline alone for data the user needs to read precisely.
limits: A single series, no axes or interaction.
